name: product_sign
description: Determine whether a product of signed integers is positive or negative. Control: same format asking if the product is even or odd... no: asking whether the first factor's absolute value is greater or less than 5.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(80):
    a=random.choice([x for x in range(-9,10) if x!=0]);b=random.choice([x for x in range(-9,10) if x!=0])
    items.append({"prompt":f"Q: Is the product ({a}) * ({b}) positive or negative?\nA: The product is","answer":" positive" if a*b>0 else " negative"})
    a=random.choice([x for x in range(1,10) if x!=5]);b=random.randint(1,9)
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Is the number {a} greater or less than 5?\nA: The number is","answer":" greater" if a>5 else " less"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
